Setup.Name: Quckstart connections
Setup.Manifest:
Version: 1.0

MqttConnections:
  - Name: "My broker"
    Endpoint:
      Port: 32007
      Address: "mymqtt-broker.net"
      EnableTls: false

OtelConnections:
  - Name: "My Otel server"
    ServiceName: "my-service"
    ServiceNamespace: "my-service-namespace"
    Endpoint:
      Protocol: "http"
      Port: 32014
      Address: "my-otel-collector.net"
      EnableTls: false
